title: Site-Directed Mutagenesis Mediated by Molecular Modeling and Docking and Its Effect on the Protein-Protein Interactions of the bHLH Transcription Factors SPATULA, HECATE1, and INDEHISCENT.
authors: Lopez-Gomez, Pablo; De La Mora-Franco, Daniela; Herrera-Ubaldo, Humberto; Diaz-Quezada, Corina; Brieba, Luis G; de Folter, Stefan
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2和分子对接预测bHLH转录因子SPT/HEC1/IND的蛋白-蛋白互作位点，并通过定点突变和BiFC验证，虽聚焦TF蛋白间互作而非TF-DNA结合，但结构建模与对接方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系研究。
abstract: The aim of this study was to investigate the biological relevance of predicted sites involved in protein-protein interaction formation by bHLH transcription factors associated with gynoecium development in Arabidopsis (Arabidopsis thaliana). We used AlphaFold2 to generate three-dimensional protein structures of the bHLH proteins SPATULA (SPT), HECATE1 (HEC1), and INDEHISCENT (IND). These structures were subjected to molecular docking using the HawkDock server, enabling the identification of potential interaction sites. PCR-based site-directed mutagenesis was used to modify the predicted interaction sites, followed by testing for protein-protein interaction formation using Bimolecular Fluorescence Complementation (BiFC) assays. Furthermore, these modified versions were overexpressed in Arabidopsis to observe whether gynoecium and fruit development would be affected. BiFC assays with the modified versions revealed a complete loss of the SPT-HEC1 interaction and a strong reduction in the SPT-IND interaction. The overexpression experiments in Arabidopsis showed that the 35S::SPT-4A line exhibited strong phenotypes in the development of the medial tissues of the gynoecium, resulting in reduced seed number and shorter fruits. In the 35S::HEC1-2A line, a reduced seed number and shorter fruits were also observed, but no other obvious defects were observed. Finally, the 35S::IND-3A line was less affected than the 35S::IND line. In the latter, medial tissue development was strongly affected, while in the 35S::IND-3A line, it was only slightly affected; however, a reduced seed number and shorter fruits were observed. In summary, the predicted interaction sites are relevant and, when modified, affect gynoecium development in Arabidopsis. The findings demonstrate that predictive computational tools represent a viable strategy for a deeper understanding of protein-protein interactions.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨拟南芥（*Arabidopsis thaliana*）中与雌蕊发育相关的bHLH转录因子形成蛋白-蛋白相互作用所预测位点的生物学相关性。我们使用AlphaFold2生成了bHLH蛋白SPATULA（SPT）、HECATE1（HEC1）和INDEHISCENT（IND）的三维蛋白质结构。这些结构通过HawkDock服务器进行分子对接，从而识别潜在的相互作用位点。基于PCR的定点突变用于修饰预测的相互作用位点，随后通过双分子荧光互补（BiFC）实验检测蛋白-蛋白相互作用的形成。此外，将这些修饰版本在拟南芥中过表达，以观察雌蕊和果实发育是否受到影响。使用修饰版本的BiFC实验显示，SPT-HEC1相互作用完全丧失，而SPT-IND相互作用显著减弱。拟南芥中的过表达实验表明，35S::SPT-4A株系在雌蕊中间组织发育中表现出强烈表型，导致种子数量减少和果实变短。在35S::HEC1-2A株系中，也观察到种子数量减少和果实变短，但未观察到其他明显缺陷。最后，35S::IND-3A株系受的影响小于35S::IND株系。后者中，中间组织发育受到强烈影响，而在35S::IND-3A株系中仅受到轻微影响；然而，仍观察到种子数量减少和果实变短。总之，预测的相互作用位点具有相关性，其修饰会影响拟南芥的雌蕊发育。研究结果表明，预测性计算工具是深入理解蛋白-蛋白相互作用的可行策略。
